PRTS：博士，首次外勤请先从撤离信标撤离。: PRTS: Doctor, on your first operation please extract at the extraction beacon first.
沿道路寻找深入入口，按交互键选择路线进入下一层。越往深处，敌人越强，收获也越好。: Follow the roads to the way deeper and press the interact key to pick a route to the next floor. The deeper you go, the stronger the enemies and the better the rewards.
第 5 层设有撤离信标。进入撤离区域停留数秒即可返回罗德岛，携带的物品一同带回。: Floor 5 has an extraction beacon. Stay inside the extraction zone for a few seconds to return to Rhodes Island with everything you carry. On your first operation, extract at the beacon.
系统同步完成。欢迎回来，博士。: System synchronisation complete. Welcome back, Doctor.
博士，您终于醒了……罗德岛的情况不太好，我们需要您。: Doctor, you're finally awake... Things aren't good on Rhodes Island. We need you.
外勤队已归舰。带回的物资已送往收货区，博士。: The field team is back aboard. The supplies brought back have gone to the Receiving Area, Doctor.
……回来就好。先去医疗部，然后看看你带回了什么。: ...You're back, that's what matters. Go to Medical first, then see what you brought home.
博士，外勤不是郊游。备齐装备，贵重的东西先投保，如果投保的装备遗落在外勤区域，罗: Doctor, field work is no field trip. Get properly equipped and insure anything valuable first; if insured gear is left behind out there, a Rhodes Island squad will go and recover it.
哟，博士！工程部那群人说总控台要是不修好，什么都升不了级。电线、继电器、灯泡，带: Hey, Doctor! Engineering says nothing gets upgraded until the hub console is fixed. Bring back wires, relays and bulbs and I'll install it for you. The fee's extra, of course.
商店重新营业！不过我这儿只收赤金。: The store is open again! Mind you, I only take Pure Gold.
博士，每十层之后设有前进据点，到达后可以在那里补给与撤离。: Doctor, there is a forward outpost after every ten floors. Once there, you can resupply and extract.
博士，外勤区域里有干员留下的行动痕迹……她应该还在附近。把这些线索交给人事部，就: Doctor, an operator has left signs of activity out in the field... She should still be nearby. Hand these leads to Personnel and they can track her down.
舰体修复到这个程度，罗德岛可以离开切尔诺伯格了。博士，航线由你决定。: With the hull repaired this far, Rhodes Island can leave Chernobog. Doctor, the course is yours to set.
工程部与科研部申请恢复运转，博士。: Engineering and Research request to resume operations, Doctor.
博士，二层的农业舱修好了！大家说想吃点热的……: Doctor, the farm deck on Deck 2 is fixed! Everyone says they'd love something hot to eat...
罗德岛全部部门恢复运转。博士，接下来的航程，由你决定。: All departments of Rhodes Island are back in operation. Doctor, the voyage ahead is yours to decide.

在整备台穿上一件装备: Put on a piece of gear at the Loadout Bench
在后勤柜台为一件装备投保: Insure a piece of gear at the Logistics Counter
在可露希尔的商店买一瓶特供药剂: Buy a special potion at Closure's Store
在沙盘上指挥罗德岛号航行: Sail Rhodes Island from the sand table
在新的地区完成一份合同: Complete a contract in a new region
在加工站完成一次加工: Finish a job at the Workshop
建成科研部并开始一项研究: Build Research and start a project
建成食堂，出发前用一次餐: Build the Canteen and eat before a contract
